newsitem.title: USA: Ralston up on earnings surprise - analyst.
newsitem.headline: Ralston up on earnings surprise - analyst.

text.p: Ralston Purina Co shares rose 2-3/8 to 68-1/2 after the company reported stronger than expected earnings for the fiscal fourth quarter.
"Earnings were a surprise," said Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette analyst William Leach.
Ralston reported operating earnings before charges and other items of $1.00 a primary share for the fourth quarter ended September 30, up from $0.72 a year ago.
Leach said he had been expecting earnings for the quarter of $0.81 a share. According to First Call, the consensus for the quarter was $0.79, with a range of $0.75 to $0.83.
Leach added that Ralston's year-ago earnings of $0.72 a share did not represent an easy comparison. Fourth-quarter 1995 results had been a sharp increase from the $0.40 it earned in the 1994 period.
